owner.input_bytes: caller-owned synchronous borrow; provider retains no pointer after return
owner.outputs: caller-owned writable scalar/status storage; no transfer resource is created
owner.wrapper: Client is a verified stateless access value, not a native resource owner
owner.native_library: linked consumer owns library availability for every call

thread.concurrency: concurrent calls with disjoint outputs and correctly borrowed inputs are supported
thread.native_cleanup: none; provider creates no per-call or retained native resource

source_lease.reason: no callback registration or retained context exists

stop.reason: no asynchronous operation or producer exists

drain.postcondition: provider has finished reading input and writing outputs; no work, pointer, callback or cleanup responsibility remains

release.reason: no native allocation, handle, transferred buffer, subscription or background owner is created

queue.overflow_policy: not applicable; no queue is admitted

memory_preconditions: Accepted nonempty checksum input denotes readable memory without concurrent mutation through return; null is allowed only for zero length.
Outputs are nonnull, aligned, writable, mutually disjoint and disjoint from input; each mechanically valid output is cleared before other argument validation.
Bootstrap accepts exactly 64 writable bytes; valid output is cleared before checking version and wrong capacity is rejected without writing.
The Rust wrapper supplies borrows and stack outputs that satisfy these obligations; it rejects input above 65536 before calling C.
Raw C callers remain responsible for allocation validity and aliasing; arbitrary dangling pointers cannot be validated.

mechanisms.responsibility: author-owned C11 ABI consumed by locked bindgen; provider compile checks scalar/error layout
bounded input borrow, unsigned checksum, safe output initialization and status return; no retained state
fixed bootstrap first; interface mismatch before profile mismatch; no checksum Client until identities match
bounded Rust slice, call-frame liveness and disjoint outputs; native status/domain/code become Result without a second resource state machine

identity.bootstrap_payload: raw interface digest[32] followed by resolved profile digest[32]
identity.unknown_version: Unsupported after clearing a valid output
identity.generated_sources: bindgen raw declarations and matching generated identity arrays are mandatory; no handwritten fallback or default identity
